extracted.name: Maple thyme carrots
extracted.description: Make these roasted carrots, flavoured with maple and thyme, in the air fryer for a side that's ideal for a special occasion, such as Christmas dinner
ingredient_lines: 750g carrots (no need to peel), scrubbed, trimmed and halved lengthways if thick
instruction_lines: Heat the air fryer to 180C. Put the carrots in a bowl, drizzle over the oil and season well. Toss to coat, then tip into the air fryer and spread out evenly. Roast for 25-30 mins until the carrots are tender when pierced with a knife and starting to turn golden.
Whisk the maple syrup, thyme and vinegar together in a small bowl, then season. Drizzle over the carrots and mix to coat. Roast for another 5-10 mins until sticky and glazed.
